name: Cryonite-SC
description: Cryonite-SC is a scandium-aluminum-lithium alloy with a quantum-engineered lattice that undergoes a controlled martensitic phase transformation at a precisely programmable trigger temperature — snapping from a flexible, low-strength configuration to a rigid, ultra-high-strength configuration with no intermediate states and no hysteresis. The transition temperature can be set during fabrication anywhere from -40°C to 600°C, and the transformation is fully reversible over millions of cycles without fatigue. This gives Cryonite-SC the unique property of being a programmable structural material that changes its mechanical identity on command.
applications: adaptive armor that hardens on impact
surgical tools that flex during insertion and lock rigid for operation
story_hooks: A batch of Cryonite-SC was fabricated with an incorrectly set trigger temperature — the armor panels built from it are hardening at body temperature rather than impact temperature, trapping the wearers inside rigid shells, and the manufacturer is desperately trying to suppress the story.

A Tier 2 underground surgeon is using Cryonite-SC tools for procedures that Spire-tier hospitals won't perform — the tools are genuinely excellent, but they were sourced from a supplier whose fabrication license was revoked for safety violations.

Someone has engineered a weapon that rapidly cycles the temperature of Cryonite-SC structural components in a building between its two phase states — used as a resonance attack, it's slowly fatiguing a tower's skeleton in a way that will look like natural materials failure when it collapses.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Combat Exoskeleton Lite CEL-3
